meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 给你做代码整理和重构时,它会先弄清你的目标和代码结构,再制定计划,分小步修改;每改一步就自动检查有没有出错,改完还会跑全部测试和检查,确保结果没搞坏原有功能。
howto.when: 当你提到 “refactor”、“cleanup”、“restructure” 等关键词,或使用 /refactor 命令时触发;若目标不明确,它会先问你想要什么结果。

say.note: 它会用保守方式重构,每步跑测试。

say.text: /refactor 把验证逻辑提取成单独模块
say.note: 它会先分析依赖再做拆分。
允许更大改动,仍会测试兜底。

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor, Claude analyzes the code, plans, then applies small changes with tests after each step, and runs full regression checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'refactor', 'cleanup', 'restructure', or the /refactor command. If the goal is unclear, it asks for clarification first.

say_en.note: Refactors conservatively and tests after each step.

say_en.text: /refactor extract validation into a separate module
say_en.note: It analyzes dependencies first, then splits.
